system.description:
Grants the ability to burrow into dirt and stone-like ground.

  • Level 1: Tunnel up to 10 metres per hour
  • Level 2: Tunnel up to 30 metres per hour
  • Level 3: Tunnel up to 100 metres per hour
  • Level 4: Tunnel up to 300 metres per hour
  • Level 5: Tunnel up to 1 kph
  • Level 6: Tunnel up to 3 kph
